svg.title: Barista — Man
svg.desc: A fictional man working as barista, wearing an apron. Visible work cue: A rounded portafilter with a long straight handle sits above a separate espresso cup and saucer. The person is on the right, with the work cue on the left. Appearance: short curls, a softly squared face.
